title: RENAME gc_spl release repository
author: ijnek
body:
I would like to rename the [gc_spl-release](https://github.com/ros2-gbp/gc_spl-release/settings) repo to be **game_controller_spl-release**, to match the name of the [source repository](https://github.com/ros-sports/game_controller_spl) that has undergone a name change from gc_spl -> game_controller_spl, to be more descriptive.

I think the following things also have to happen after the rename:
* Update `sports.tf ` (I can't do)
* Update entries in rosdistro to point to new release repo. (I can do)

Please tell me if I'm forgetting anything.
